design.statement: the amended statement of amendment.md section 2: there are specific text-beginning and text-ending signs in the Indus corpus, in the exact sense battery NB-1 makes checkable; a verdict on it is not a verdict on Yadav et al. (2010)'s original Phase-43 statement

battery.name: NB-1
battery.population: each corpus layer's own numbering and segmentation; no re-segmentation, no renumbering, and no crosswalk inside a run
battery.classes: initial / terminal / medial for sequences of length >= 2; length-1 sequences counted and reported separately, entering no count; I + T + M = N exactly

arms.arm_1: the strict corpus: the Mahadevan-lineage V3 layer as held in the database, identified, exported, and pinned at step 0
arms.arm_2: the Holdat layer in its own numbering, through crosswalk v1 at the freeze pins

decision.reappearance: per class (DD-054-1): a class reappears iff the share of arm 1's strong set whose members are also strong in arm 2 in the same class, through the pinned crosswalk, is >= 1/2
decision.denominators: DD-054-5: arm-1 strong signs unmapped, conflict-paired, or below the floor in arm 2 count as not reappeared in the primary measure and are named with their reason (TOO THIN / UNMAPPED / CONFLICT); the sensitivity excluding named signs is reported with the same prominence; the verdict follows the primary

null.construction: label permutation: arm 2's strong-set membership labels permuted over arm 2's classifiable signs, set sizes and the mapping table held fixed

precedence: either arm-1 strong set empty -> NOT SUPPORTED
both classes reappear -> the pooled overlap decides: above the chance level SUPPORTED; at or below NOT SUPPORTED
a class short -> overlap at or below the chance level NOT SUPPORTED; overlap above INCONCLUSIVE with the rates stated

falsifier.text: This claim, as evaluated under battery NB-1 (the Spec 054 amendment, as frozen), is falsified if any of the following holds when the frozen battery is run on the frozen arm-1 and arm-2 corpora: (1) either arm-1 positional-strong set (opening or closing) is empty; (2) for either class, fewer than half of arm 1's positional-strong signs are also positional-strong in arm 2 in the same class, through the pinned crosswalk; or (3) the pooled cross-arm overlap of positional-strong signs does not exceed the 95th percentile of the 999-shuffle label-permutation null — the three conditions applied under the precedence rule of the Spec 054 amendment (§5.5).

design.verdict_wordings: amendment.md section 9, verbatim; the word RE-EARNED appears in no amended wording; the parent claim's recorded status is moved by no verdict
design.spec045_fence: Spec 045's 'Holdat final-position concentration' and this spec's 'closing-strong under NB-1' are different quantities, distinctly named in every outcome record
